content.short: Uniswap Web3 React is a basic, editable library for deploying Ethereum dApps.
content.description: Uniswap's Web3 development framework speeds up the creation of Web3 dapps by turning ideas into functional demos. It provides a quick-start path, allowing developers to run yarn commands to generate the basic frontend for a dapp, with WalletConnect as the default authentication method. Built to streamline workflows, the project invites developers to contribute toward greater simplicity and usability in Web3 tooling. This open-source effort focuses on ease of use and rapid prototyping for a smoother developer experience.
